Here's a list of my selected public speaking occasions including poster and oral presentations at international conferences.
If available, you'll also find slides, related papers, and recordings.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/html/timeline.css">
```

```{r tl-speaking, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

conferences <- read.xlsx("conferences.xlsx") |>
  arrange(-Year, -Month)

month_abb <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun",
               "Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

html_entry <- function(row) {
  # Type
  type_cls <- if (is.na(row$Type))                            "upcoming"
              else if (grepl("oral", row$Type, ignore.case=TRUE)) "talk"
              else                                                 "poster"
  type_lbl <- c(talk = "Talk", poster = "Poster", upcoming = "Upcoming")[type_cls]

  # Date
  mon <- if (!is.na(row$Month)) month_abb[as.integer(row$Month)] else ""

  # Title
  title <- if (!is.na(row$Title)) row$Title else "Upcoming presentation"

  # Venue: acronym · city
  venue <- paste0(row$Code_Name, " &middot; ", row$Location)

  # Links — skip NA or labels flagged with "(NA)"
  link_tags <- ""
  for (k in 1:2) {
    nm  <- row[[paste0("Link_", k, "_name")]]
    url <- row[[paste0("Link_", k)]]
    if (!is.na(nm) && !is.na(url) && !grepl("\\(NA\\)", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      link_tags <- paste0(link_tags,
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', url, nm))
    }
  }
  if (nchar(link_tags) > 0)
    link_tags <- paste0('<div class="tl-links">', link_tags, '</div>')

  entry_cls <- if (type_cls == "upcoming") ' tl-upcoming' else ''

  # Unique ID for map linking
  entry_id <- tolower(gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "-", paste0("talk-", row$Code_Name, "-", row$Year)))

  sprintf(
    '<div class="tl-entry%s" id="%s">
<div class="tl-date">%s<br>%s</div>
<div class="tl-card">
<span class="tl-type tl-type-%s">%s</span>
<div class="tl-title">%s</div>
<div class="tl-venue">%s</div>
%s
</div>
</div>',
    entry_cls, entry_id, mon, row$Year,
    type_cls, type_lbl,
    title, venue, link_tags
  )
}

raw_entries <- apply(conferences, 1, function(x) html_entry(as.list(x)))

# Insert year dividers when the year changes
years <- conferences$Year
output <- character()
prev_year <- NULL
for (i in seq_along(raw_entries)) {
  yr <- years[i]
  if (is.null(prev_year) || yr != prev_year) {
    output <- c(output, sprintf('<div class="tl-year-divider"><span>%s</span></div>', yr))
    prev_year <- yr
  }
  output <- c(output, raw_entries[i])
}

cat('<div class="tl-wrapper">\n', paste(output, collapse = "\n"), '\n</div>\n')
cat('<script>
function toggleSummary(btn) {
  const summary = btn.nextElementSibling;
  const isOpen  = summary.classList.contains("open");
  summary.classList.toggle("open", !isOpen);
  btn.classList.toggle("open", !isOpen);
}
</script>\n')
```

## My scientific adventure

```{r map-data, echo=FALSE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(jsonlite)

conferences <- read_excel(path = "conferences.xlsx")

conf_coords <- tidygeocoder::geocode(.tbl = conferences, city = Location) |>
  filter(!is.na(lat)) |>
  select(Code_Name, Year, Location, lat, long)

uni_coords <- data.frame(
  name  = c("KU Leuven", "UMC Utrecht", "Memorial Sloan Kettering"),
  city  = c("Leuven",    "Utrecht",     "New York")
) |>
  tidygeocoder::geocode(city = city) |>
  select(name, lat, long)

cat(sprintf(
  "<script>\nconst conferenceData = %s;\nconst universityData = %s;\n</script>",
  toJSON(conf_coords, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  toJSON(uni_coords,  auto_unbox = TRUE)
))
```

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>

<style>
#travel-map {
  height: 520px;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,40,100,0.10);
  margin: 1.5em 0;
  z-index: 0;
}

/* Popup styling */
.map-popup .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper {
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,40,100,0.15);
  font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  padding: 0;
}
.map-popup .leaflet-popup-content {
  margin: 10px 14px;
}
.map-popup .leaflet-popup-tip {
  box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,40,100,0.10);
}
.popup-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #1a1a2e;
}
.popup-detail {
  color: #666;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.popup-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.popup-badge-conf { background: #fce8e8; color: #c0392b; }
.popup-badge-uni  { background: #e0eeff; color: #0062cc; }

.popup-scroll-link {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #007BFF;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.popup-scroll-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* Pulsing ring for university markers */
@keyframes leaflet-pulse {
  0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 0.7; }
  100% { transform: scale(2.8); opacity: 0;   }
}
.uni-pulse-ring {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(0, 123, 255, 0.35);
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  animation: leaflet-pulse 2s ease-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Legend */
.map-legend {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.93);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #555;
  line-height: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,40,100,0.10);
  border: 1px solid #e0e8f0;
}
.map-legend i {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  margin-right: 6px;
  vertical-align: middle;
  position: relative;
  top: -1px;
}
</style>

<div id="travel-map"></div>

<script>
(function () {
  /* ── Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const map = L.map('travel-map', {
    center: [38, 8],
    zoom: 3,
    minZoom: 2,
    maxBoundsViscosity: 1.0,
    maxBounds: [[-85, -180], [85, 180]],
    zoomControl: true,
    scrollWheelZoom: true,
    worldCopyJump: false
  });

  /* CartoDB Voyager — warm, detailed, with labels */
  L.tileLayer(
    'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png',
    {
      attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OSM</a> &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/">CARTO</a>',
      subdomains: 'abcd',
      maxZoom: 18
    }
  ).addTo(map);

  /* ── Scroll-to-timeline helper ──────────────────────────────────── */
  function entryId(codeName, year) {
    return 'talk-' + (codeName + '-' + year).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-');
  }

  function scrollToEntry(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    el.classList.add('tl-highlight');
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('tl-highlight'), 2000);
  }

  /* Make scrollToEntry accessible from popup links */
  window._scrollToEntry = scrollToEntry;

  /* ── Conference markers ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  conferenceData.forEach(d => {
    const id = entryId(d.Code_Name, d.Year);

    L.circleMarker([+d.lat, +d.long], {
      radius: 7,
      fillColor: '#e05555',
      color: '#fff',
      weight: 2,
      fillOpacity: 0.88
    })
    .bindPopup(
      '<div class="popup-name">' + d.Code_Name + ' ' + d.Year + '</div>' +
      '<div class="popup-detail">' + d.Location + '</div>' +
      '<a href="#" class="popup-scroll-link" onclick="window._scrollToEntry(\'' + id + '\'); return false;">Show in timeline ↓</a>',
      { className: 'map-popup', maxWidth: 200 }
    )
    .addTo(map);
  });

  /* ── University markers (with pulse) ────────────────────────────── */
  universityData.forEach(d => {
    /* Pulsing ring */
    L.marker([+d.lat, +d.long], {
      icon: L.divIcon({
        className: '',
        html: '<div class="uni-pulse-ring"></div>',
        iconSize: [20, 20],
        iconAnchor: [10, 10]
      }),
      interactive: false
    }).addTo(map);

    /* Solid dot */
    L.circleMarker([+d.lat, +d.long], {
      radius: 9,
      fillColor: '#007BFF',
      color: '#fff',
      weight: 2.5,
      fillOpacity: 0.92
    })
    .bindPopup(
      '<div class="popup-name">' + d.name + '</div>' +
      (d.name !== 'KU Leuven' ? '<div class="popup-detail">Visiting Researcher</div>' : '') +
      '<span class="popup-badge popup-badge-uni">Affiliated institution</span>',
      { className: 'map-popup', maxWidth: 200 }
    )
    .addTo(map);
  });

  /* ── Fit bounds to all points ───────────────────────────────────── */
  const allPts = [
    ...conferenceData.map(d => [+d.lat, +d.long]),
    ...universityData.map(d => [+d.lat, +d.long])
  ];
  if (allPts.length > 0) {
    map.fitBounds(allPts, { padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 5 });
  }

  /* ── Legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const legend = L.control({ position: 'bottomleft' });
  legend.onAdd = function () {
    const div = L.DomUtil.create('div', 'map-legend');
    div.innerHTML =
      '<i style="background:#e05555;"></i> Conference<br>' +
      '<i style="background:#007BFF;"></i> Affiliated institution';
    return div;
  };
  legend.addTo(map);
})();
</script>
```
